# Simulation to compare far() and plug-in forecasting

```{r ideal-simulation, eval=FALSE}
grid_forecast <- expand.grid(
  T = c(500, 1000),
  d = c(1),
  ar_strength = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  ma_strength = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  model = c("1_0", "0_1", "1_1", "2_0")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p = dplyr::case_when(
      model == "1_0" ~ 1L,
      model == "0_1" ~ 0L,
      model == "1_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "2_0" ~ 2L
    ),
    q = dplyr::case_when(
      model == "1_0" ~ 0L,
      model == "0_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "1_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "2_0" ~ 0L
    ),
    ar_strength = dplyr::if_else(p == 0, 0, ar_strength),
    ma_strength = dplyr::if_else(q == 0, 0, ma_strength)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(T, d, p, q, ar_strength, ma_strength) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(T, d, p, q, ar_strength, ma_strength)

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 50)
progressr::handlers("progress")

forecast_sim <- simulate_ideal(
  n_rep = 100,
  grid = grid_forecast,
  h_max = 10,
  train_ratio = 0.6,
  valid_ratio = 0.2,
  alpha_set = c(0.2, 0.05),
  window_types = c("expanding", "fixed"),
  Npc = 1,
  no_grid = 101,
  far_pve = 0.95,
  zeta_grid = seq(0.1, 10, length.out = 500),
  fracdiff_trim = 150,
  farma_residual_ratio_limit = 10,
  compact_errors = TRUE,
  keep_calibration = FALSE
)

future::plan(future::sequential)

saveRDS(forecast_sim, file.path(project_root, "Forecasting", "ideal_raw.rds"))

ideal_summary <- summarise_metrics(
  forecast_sim,
  summary_stat = "both",
  keep_replication_details = TRUE
)

ideal_summary <- lapply(ideal_summary, function(x) {
  if (is.data.frame(x)) dplyr::select(x, -dplyr::any_of("order_selection_method")) else x
})

saveRDS(ideal_summary, file.path(project_root, "Forecasting", "ideal_summary.rds"))
```

### Plots of RMSPE ratio
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)

plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

make_forecast_ratio_summary <- function(df,
                                        metric_col = "RMSE",
                                        method_col = "method",
                                        farma_label = "FARMA",
                                        far_label = "FAR(1)") {
  T_name <- if ("T" %in% names(df)) {
    "T"
  } else if ("n" %in% names(df)) {
    "n"
  } else {
    stop("Need `T` or `n` column.")
  }

  wide_farma <- intersect(c("RMSE_farma", "rmse_farma", "RMSE_FARMA"), names(df))

  wide_far <- intersect(c("RMSE_far", "rmse_far", "RMSE_FAR"), names(df))

  if (length(wide_farma) > 0 &&
      length(wide_far) > 0) {
    out <- df %>%
      mutate(rmse_ratio =
               .data[[wide_farma[1]]] /
               .data[[wide_far[1]]])

  } else {
    if (!metric_col %in% names(df)) {
      stop("Cannot find metric column. Change `metric_col`.")
    }

    if (!method_col %in% names(df)) {
      stop("Cannot find method column. Change `method_col`.")
    }

    group_vars <- intersect(
      c(
        T_name,
        "h",
        "window_type",
        "ar_strength",
        "ma_strength",
        "p_true",
        "q_true",
        "d",
        "d_true"
      ),
      names(df)
    )

    out <- df %>%
      mutate(
        method_use = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[method_col]])), "farma") ~ farma_label,

          str_detect(
            tolower(as.character(.data[[method_col]])),
            "far\\(1\\)|far1|far_1|plugin|far$"
          ) ~ far_label,

          TRUE ~ as.character(.data[[method_col]])
        )
      ) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars)), method_use) %>%
      summarise(metric_value = mean(.data[[metric_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = method_use, values_from = metric_value)

    if (!farma_label %in% names(out)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Cannot find FARMA method after reshaping. ",
          "Check `method_col` and method labels."
        )
      )
    }

    if (!far_label %in% names(out)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Cannot find FAR(1) method after reshaping. ",
          "Check `method_col` and method labels."
        )
      )
    }

    out <- out %>%
      mutate(rmse_ratio =
               .data[[farma_label]] /
               .data[[far_label]])
  }

  if (!"ar_strength" %in% names(out)) {
    out$ar_strength <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!"ma_strength" %in% names(out)) {
    out$ma_strength <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!"window_type" %in% names(out)) {
    out$window_type <- "Window"
  }

  psi_vals <- sort(unique(out$ar_strength[is.finite(out$ar_strength)]))

  nu_vals <- sort(unique(out$ma_strength[is.finite(out$ma_strength)]))

  out %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(.data[[T_name]]),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),

      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),

      model_label = paste0("FARFIMA(", p_true, ",1,", q_true, ")"),

      T_factor = factor(T_value, levels = sort(unique(T_value))),

      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",

        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",

        TRUE ~ as.character(window_type)
      ),

      window_type = factor(window_type, levels = c("Expanding", "Fixed")),

      model = factor(
        model,
        levels = c(
          "(1,0)",
          "(2,0)",
          "(0,1)",
          "(0,2)",
          "(1,1)",
          "(2,1)",
          "(1,2)",
          "(2,2)"
        )
      ),

      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", psi_vals)),

      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", nu_vals))
    )
}

get_T_cols <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))

  if (length(T_levels) == 1L) {
    return(setNames("#D95F02", T_levels))
  }

  cols <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A", "#66A61E")

  if (length(T_levels) > length(cols)) {
    stop("Not enough colours for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(cols[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

get_window_ltys <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))

  ltys <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash")

  if (length(window_levels) > length(ltys)) {
    stop("Not enough line types for the number of windows.")
  }

  setNames(ltys[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

get_window_shapes <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))

  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)

  if (length(window_levels) > length(shapes)) {
    stop("Not enough shapes for the number of windows.")
  }

  setNames(shapes[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

get_T_shapes <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))
  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)

  if (length(T_levels) > length(shapes)) {
    stop("Not enough shapes for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(shapes[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

plot_forecast_ratio_one_model <- function(df,
                                          model_show,
                                          title = NULL,
                                          show_legend = FALSE,
                                          value_col = "rmse_ratio",
                                          y_limits = NULL) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)

  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show))
  }

  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)

  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]

  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])

  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = .data[[value_col]],
      group = interaction(T_factor, window_type),
      colour = T_factor,
      linetype = window_type,
      shape = T_factor
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = get_T_cols(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_window_ltys(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_T_shapes(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$h)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      colour = "Sample size T",
      linetype = "Window",
      shape = "Sample size T"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) {
        "top"
      } else {
        "none"
      },

      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "vertical",

      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size, face = "bold"),

      legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),

      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),

      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),

      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),

      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),

      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )

  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)

  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)

  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }

  g
}

make_forecast_legend_manual <- function(df) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(T_factor = droplevels(T_factor),
           window_type = droplevels(window_type))

  legend_plot <- ggplot(
    df_use,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = 1,
      colour = T_factor,
      linetype = window_type,
      shape = T_factor,
      group = interaction(T_factor, window_type)
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = legend_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = legend_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = get_T_cols(df_use), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = get_window_ltys(df_use), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_T_shapes(df_use), drop = FALSE) +
    labs(colour = "Sample size T", linetype = "Window", shape = "Sample size T") +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        nrow = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(shape = unname(get_T_shapes(df_use)))
      ),
      linetype = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE),
      shape = "none"
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = legend_text_size * ggplot2::.pt) +
    paper_legend_theme(
      base_size = legend_text_size * ggplot2::.pt,
      position = "top"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box.just = "center",
      legend.justification = "center"
    )

  get_visible_legend(legend_plot)
}

make_forecast_legend_manual_core <- make_forecast_legend_manual

combine_four_forecast_models_shared_axes <- function(
    df,
    models,
    titles,
    file_name = NULL,
    width = 16,
    height = 12,
    y_limits = NULL,
    value_col = "rmse_ratio",
    y_axis_label = "RMSPE ratio to FARFIMA(1,1,0)") {
  assemble_ratio_panel_grid(
    df = df,
    models = models,
    titles = titles,
    value_col = value_col,
    plot_model = plot_forecast_ratio_one_model,
    legend = if (n_distinct(df$T_factor) > 1L ||
                 n_distinct(df$window_type) > 1L) {
      make_forecast_legend_manual(df)
    } else {
      NULL
    },
    y_axis_label = y_axis_label,
    file_name = file_name,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    y_limits = y_limits,
    common_y = TRUE,
    shared_label_size = shared_label_size
  )
}
```

### Table of RMSPE and MAPE

```{r}
ideal_point_wide <- forecast_res$ratio_summary %>%
  filter(n == 1000, window_type == "expanding", h %in% c(1, 5, 10)) %>%
  select(p_true, q_true, ar_strength, ma_strength, h, RMSE_far, RMSE_farma, MAE_far, MAE_farma) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(RMSE_far, RMSE_farma, MAE_far, MAE_farma), names_to = c("metric", "method"), names_sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(metric, method, h), values_from = value, names_sep = "_") %>%
  tab_ideal_keys()

ideal_point_latex <- tab_longtable(
  "cc*{6}{r}",
  paste0(
    "Raw RMSPE and MAPE in the ideal setting with $T=1000$ under the expanding-window scheme. ",
    "The final rows of each panel report the mean and median over the settings shown. ",
    "The smallest RMSPE within each setting and horizon is highlighted in red, and the smallest MAPE in blue."
  ),
  "tab:ideal_forecast_expanding",
  tab_horizon_header(c("$(p,d,q)$", "$(\\psi,\\nu)$"), c("Bench.", "Plug-in")),
  tab_wide_panels(
    ideal_point_wide,
    c("far", "farma"),
    list(
      list(metric = "RMSE", col = "red", label = "RMSPE"),
      list(metric = "MAE", col = "blue", label = "MAPE")
    )
  ),
  tabcolsep = "9pt"
)

cat(ideal_point_latex, sep = "\n")
```

### Plots for ECP
```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

make_ecp_summary <- function(df,
                             alpha_show = 0.05,
                             window_show = "Expanding") {
  make_interval_plot_summary(df = df, alpha_show = alpha_show) %>%
    filter(method %in% c("far", "farma"), window_type == window_show) %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(
        method,
        levels = c("far", "farma"),
        labels = c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)", "Plugin forecast")
      ),

      T_factor = droplevels(T_factor),
      window_type = droplevels(window_type)
    )
}

method_cols_ecp <- c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)" = "#1B9E77",
                     "Plugin forecast" = "#D95F02")

method_ltys_ecp <- c(
  "FARFIMA(1,1,0)" = "longdash",
  "Plugin forecast" = "solid"
)

get_T_shapes_ecp <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))

  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)

  if (length(T_levels) > length(shapes)) {
    stop("Not enough shapes for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(shapes[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

get_T_ltys_ecp <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))

  ltys <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash")

  if (length(T_levels) > length(ltys)) {
    stop("Not enough line types for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(ltys[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

make_ecp_legend_no_window <- function(df) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(method = droplevels(method), T_factor = droplevels(T_factor))

  show_sample_size <- n_distinct(df_use$T_factor) > 1L

  legend_plot <- ggplot(
    df_use,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = ECP,
      colour = method,
      linetype = method,
      shape = T_factor,
      group = interaction(method, T_factor)
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = legend_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = legend_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_ecp, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_T_shapes_ecp(df_use), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys_ecp, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      colour = "Forecasting method",
      linetype = "Forecasting method",
      shape = "Sample size T"
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        nrow = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(shape = NA)
      ),
      linetype = "none",
      shape = if (show_sample_size) {
        guide_legend(
          order = 2,
          nrow = 1,
          byrow = TRUE,
          override.aes = list(colour = "black", linetype = 0)
        )
      } else {
        "none"
      }
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = legend_text_size * ggplot2::.pt) +
    paper_legend_theme(
      base_size = legend_text_size * ggplot2::.pt,
      position = "top"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box.just = "center",
      legend.justification = "center"
    )

  get_visible_legend(legend_plot)
}

plot_ecp_one_model <- function(df,
                               model_show,
                               title = NULL,
                               alpha_show = 0.05,
                               y_limits = NULL) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)

  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show))
  }

  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)

  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]

  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])

  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = ECP,
      group = interaction(method, T_factor),
      colour = method,
      linetype = method,
      shape = T_factor
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1 - alpha_show,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_ecp, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys_ecp, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = get_T_shapes_ecp(df), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$h)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.05),
      labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)
    ) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),

      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),

      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),

      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),

      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),

      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),

      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),

      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )

  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)

  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)

  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }

  g
}

combine_four_ecp_models_shared_axes <- function(df,
                                                models,
                                                titles,
                                                alpha_show = 0.05,
                                                file_name = NULL,
                                                width = 16,
                                                height = 12,
                                                y_limits = NULL,
                                                y_axis_label = "ECP") {
  if (length(models) != 4) {
    stop("`models` must contain exactly four model labels.")
  }

  if (length(titles) != 4) {
    stop("`titles` must contain exactly four plot titles.")
  }

  df_use <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) %in% models)

  if (nrow(df_use) == 0) {
    stop("No observations remain for the requested models.")
  }

  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    y_range <- range(c(df_use$ECP, 1 - alpha_show), na.rm = TRUE)

    pad <- 0.04 * diff(y_range)

    if (!is.finite(pad) || pad == 0) {
      pad <- 0.03
    }

    y_limits <- range(c(y_range[1] - pad, y_range[2] + pad), na.rm = TRUE)

    y_limits[1] <- max(0, y_limits[1])

    y_limits[2] <- min(1, y_limits[2])
  }

  legend <- make_ecp_legend_no_window(df_use)

  p1 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[1],
    title = titles[1],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )

  p2 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[2],
    title = titles[2],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )

  p3 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[3],
    title = titles[3],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )

  p4 <- plot_ecp_one_model(
    df = df_use,
    model_show = models[4],
    title = titles[4],
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )

  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1,
                                  p2,
                                  p3,
                                  p4,
                                  ncol = 2,
                                  align = "hv",
                                  axis = "tblr")

  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      y_axis_label,
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("Forecast horizon h",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.022,
                        size = shared_label_size)

  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )

  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }

  final_plot
}
```

```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

get_T_cols <- function(df) {
  T_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$T_factor))

  if (length(T_levels) == 1L) {
    return(setNames("#D95F02", T_levels))
  }

  cols <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A", "#66A61E")

  if (length(T_levels) > length(cols)) {
    stop("Not enough colours for the number of sample sizes.")
  }

  setNames(cols[seq_along(T_levels)], T_levels)
}

get_window_ltys <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))

  ltys <- c("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash")

  setNames(ltys[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

get_window_shapes <- function(df) {
  window_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$window_type))

  shapes <- c(16, 17, 15, 18)

  setNames(shapes[seq_along(window_levels)], window_levels)
}

make_forecast_legend_manual <- function(df) {
  make_forecast_legend_manual_core(df)
}

make_score_ratio_summary <- function(df,
                                     alpha_show = 0.05,
                                     score_col = "Score") {
  df_use <- make_interval_plot_summary(df = df, alpha_show = alpha_show)

  if (!score_col %in% names(df_use)) {
    stop(paste("Cannot find score column:", score_col))
  }

  score_summary <- df_use %>%
    group_by(
      T_value,
      T_factor,
      h,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      psi_label,
      nu_label,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      model,
      model_label,
      window_type,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(score_value = mean(.data[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = score_value)

  if (!"farma" %in% names(score_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find the FARMA score after reshaping. Check the `method` labels.")
  }

  if (!"far" %in% names(score_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find the FAR(1) score after reshaping. Check the `method` labels.")
  }

  score_summary %>%
    mutate(score_ratio = farma / far)
}
```

### Plot of weighted interval score ratio

The WIS combines the 80\% and 95\% prediction intervals with the absolute
error of the point forecast. Values below one favour the FARFIMA model over
the FARFIMA$(1,1,0)$ benchmark.

```{r}
make_ideal_wis_ratio_data <- function(df) {
  required_cols <- c(
    "n",
    "h",
    "ar_strength",
    "ma_strength",
    "p_true",
    "q_true",
    "window_type",
    "method",
    "WIS"
  )

  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(df))) {
    stop("Missing required WIS columns.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (nrow(df) == 0L || any(!is.finite(df$WIS))) {
    stop("WIS data must be non-empty and finite.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- df %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(n),
      T_factor = factor(T_value, levels = sort(unique(T_value))),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      method = case_when(
        method == "farma" ~ "farma",
        method == "far" ~ "far",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      window_type = factor(window_type, levels = c("Expanding", "Fixed")),
      model = factor(
        paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
        levels = c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")
      ),
      model_label = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", sort(
        unique(ar_strength)
      ))),
      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", sort(
        unique(ma_strength)
      )))
    )

  if (anyNA(out$method) ||
      anyNA(out$window_type) || anyNA(out$model)) {
    stop("Unknown method, window, or model in WIS data.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- out %>%
    group_by(
      T_value,
      T_factor,
      h,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      psi_label,
      nu_label,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      model,
      model_label,
      window_type,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(WIS = mean(WIS), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = WIS)

  if (!all(c("far", "farma") %in% names(out))) {
    stop("Missing FAR or FARMA WIS.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(score_ratio = farma / far)

  if (any(!is.finite(out$score_ratio))) {
    stop("WIS ratios must be finite.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out
}
```

### Plots comparing the conformal methods

ECP and IS of the plug-in forecast under the three conformal methods (SR:
scaled residual band, NS: nonconformity score, AC: adaptive conformal) for
$T = 1000$ and the expanding window.

```{r}
rule_cols <- c(SR = "#1B9E77", NS = "#D95F02", AC = "#7570B3")
rule_ltys <- c(SR = "longdash", NS = "solid", AC = "dashed")
rule_shapes <- c(SR = 15, NS = 16, AC = 17)

make_rule_2x2_data <- function(df, alpha_show) {
  make_interval_plot_summary(df = df, alpha_show = alpha_show) %>%
    filter(method == "farma", T_value == 1000, window_type == "Expanding") %>%
    transmute(
      model,
      psi_label,
      nu_label,
      h,
      ECP_SR = ECP,
      ECP_NS = ECP_scores,
      ECP_AC = ECP_aci,
      IS_SR = Score,
      IS_NS = Score_scores,
      IS_AC = Score_aci
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      -c(model, psi_label, nu_label, h),
      names_to = c(".value", "rule"),
      names_pattern = "(ECP|IS)_(.*)"
    ) %>%
    mutate(rule = factor(rule, levels = names(rule_cols)))
}

plot_rule_one_model <- function(df,
                                model_show,
                                value_col,
                                title,
                                reference = NULL,
                                y_limits = NULL,
                                free_y = FALSE) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)

  pq <- as.integer(strsplit(gsub("[() ]", "", model_show), ",")[[1]])

  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = .data[[value_col]],
      group = rule,
      colour = rule,
      linetype = rule,
      shape = rule
    )
  )

  if (!is.null(reference)) {
    g <- g +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = reference,
        colour = "black",
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = reference_line_width
      )
  }

  g <- g +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = rule_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = rule_ltys, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = rule_shapes, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = plot_title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )

  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    g <- g + coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)
  }

  facet_scales <- if (free_y) "free_y" else "fixed"

  if (pq[1] > 0 && pq[2] == 0) {
    g <- g + facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed, scales = facet_scales)
  } else if (pq[1] == 0 && pq[2] > 0) {
    g <- g + facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed, scales = facet_scales)
  } else if (pq[1] > 0 && pq[2] > 0) {
    g <- g + facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed, scales = facet_scales)
  }

  g
}

make_rule_legend <- function() {
  legend_data <- expand.grid(
    rule = factor(names(rule_cols), levels = names(rule_cols)),
    x = c(1, 2)
  )

  legend_plot <- ggplot(
    legend_data,
    aes(x = x, y = 1, colour = rule, linetype = rule, shape = rule)
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = legend_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = legend_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = rule_cols) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = rule_ltys) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = rule_shapes) +
    labs(
      colour = "Conformal methods",
      linetype = "Conformal methods",
      shape = "Conformal methods"
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = legend_text_size * ggplot2::.pt) +
    paper_legend_theme(
      base_size = legend_text_size * ggplot2::.pt,
      position = "top"
    )

  get_visible_legend(legend_plot)
}

combine_four_rule_models_shared_axes <- function(df,
                                                 value_col,
                                                 y_axis_label,
                                                 reference = NULL,
                                                 y_limits = NULL,
                                                 free_y = FALSE,
                                                 file_name = NULL,
                                                 width = 16,
                                                 height = 14) {
  models <- c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")
  titles <- c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)", "FARFIMA(0,1,1)", "FARFIMA(2,1,0)", "FARFIMA(1,1,1)")

  panels <- lapply(seq_along(models), function(k) {
    plot_rule_one_model(
      df = df,
      model_show = models[k],
      value_col = value_col,
      title = titles[k],
      reference = reference,
      y_limits = y_limits,
      free_y = free_y
    )
  })

  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    plotlist = panels,
    ncol = 2,
    align = "hv",
    axis = "tblr"
  )

  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(main_grid, x = 0.078, y = 0.085, width = 0.90, height = 0.89) +
    cowplot::draw_label(y_axis_label, x = 0.020, y = 0.53, angle = 90, size = shared_label_size) +
    cowplot::draw_label("Forecast horizon h", x = 0.53, y = 0.022, size = shared_label_size)

  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    make_rule_legend(),
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.08, 1)
  )

  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(filename = file_name, plot = final_plot, width = width, height = height)
  }

  final_plot
}

rule_data_80 <- make_rule_2x2_data(forecast_res$interval_summary, alpha_show = 0.20)

p_rule_ecp_80 <- combine_four_rule_models_shared_axes(
  df = rule_data_80,
  value_col = "ECP",
  y_axis_label = "ECP",
  reference = 0.80,
  y_limits = c(0.7, 0.9),
  file_name = file.path(ideal_plot_dir, "forecast_conformal_ecp_80_2x2.pdf")
)

p_rule_is_80 <- combine_four_rule_models_shared_axes(
  df = rule_data_80,
  value_col = "IS",
  y_axis_label = "IS",
  free_y = TRUE,
  file_name = file.path(ideal_plot_dir, "forecast_conformal_is_80_2x2.pdf")
)

p_rule_ecp_80
p_rule_is_80
```




### Table comparing the conformal methods

```{r}
ideal_conformal_latex <- tab_conformal_wide(
  forecast_res$interval_summary %>%
    filter(n == 1000, window_type == "expanding", method == "farma"),
  paste0(
    "Raw ECP, CPD, and IS of the SR, NS, and AC bands for the plug-in method in the ideal setting with $T=1000$ ",
    "under the expanding-window scheme, averaged over all short-memory orders and dependence strengths."
  ),
  "tab:ideal_conformal"
)

cat(ideal_conformal_latex, sep = "\n")
```


### Table of interval forecasting scores

```{r}
ideal_interval_wide <- forecast_res$interval_summary %>%
  filter(n == 1000, window_type == "expanding", h %in% c(1, 5, 10), abs(alpha - 0.20) < 1e-10) %>%
  select(p_true, q_true, ar_strength, ma_strength, h, method, ECP, CPD, Score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(method, h), values_from = c(ECP, CPD, Score), names_sep = "_") %>%
  tab_ideal_keys()

ideal_interval_latex <- tab_longtable(
  "cc*{6}{r}",
  paste0(
    "Raw ECP, CPD, and IS for 80\\% SR prediction intervals in the ideal setting with $T=1000$ under the expanding-window scheme. ",
    "The final rows of each panel report the mean and median over the settings shown. ",
    "The smallest CPD within each setting and horizon is highlighted in red, and the smallest IS in blue."
  ),
  "tab:ideal_interval_expanding",
  tab_horizon_header(c("$(p,d,q)$", "$(\\psi,\\nu)$"), c("Bench.", "Plug-in")),
  tab_wide_panels(
    ideal_interval_wide,
    c("far", "farma"),
    list(
      list(metric = "ECP", col = NA, label = "ECP"),
      list(metric = "CPD", col = "red", label = "CPD"),
      list(metric = "Score", col = "blue", label = "IS")
    )
  ),
  tabcolsep = "9pt"
)

cat(ideal_interval_latex, sep = "\n")
```



### Table of weighted interval scores

```{r}
ideal_wis_long <- forecast_res$wis_summary %>%
  filter(n == 1000, window_type == "expanding") %>%
  mutate(Method = ifelse(method == "far", "Bench.", "Plug-in")) %>%
  tab_ideal_keys()

ideal_wis_latex <- tab_longtable(
  "cclrrrrrrrrrr",
  paste0(
    "Raw WIS in the ideal setting with $T=1000$ under the expanding-window scheme. ",
    "WIS combines the absolute point forecast error with the IS of the 80\\% and 95\\% SR prediction intervals. ",
    "The final rows report the mean and median over the settings shown. ",
    "The smallest WIS within each setting and horizon is highlighted in purple."
  ),
  "tab:ideal_wis_expanding",
  tab_wis_header(c("$(p,d,q)$", "$(\\psi,\\nu)$")),
  tab_wis_rows(ideal_wis_long, c("Bench.", "Plug-in")),
  tabcolsep = "3pt"
)

cat(ideal_wis_latex, sep = "\n")
```
